messages:
maria_support: Hey team — customer FathomAI (dedicated EU2) reporting recurring 429s + p95 token latency spikes for the past ~40m after a traffic burst. They say it started right after an autoscale event. Pool: eu2-dedicated-7, node gpu-13. Can someone triage? Request samples: req-93a1, req-93a2.

infra-bot: Alert: [eu2-dedicated-7] slice-0 (gpu-13) SM util 94% for 3+ intervals, throttling=observed, created_at=2309123400.

tessa_sre: Looking. Do we see MIG sibling crosstalk or packing fraction issues? Can someone paste nvidia-smi mig -lgci and dmesg lines from gpu-13? Also need API logs for the 429s (trace ids).

jon_eng: Quick dump from node (pulled at 2309123460):
```
# nvidia-smi mig -lgci
GPU 13: MIG Instances: 3
 - slice-A (1g.5gb) SM: 92%
 - slice-B (2g.10gb) SM: 6%
 - slice-C (1g.5gb) SM: 88%
```
`dmesg` shows repeated kernel warnings about peer-to-peer NVLink retries. Notable: "GPU 13: mmu_tlb_miss high, scheduling wait"

jon_eng: Repro I ran locally against a staging reserved pool: send 40 concurrent streams, 1k tokens each, using model:redwood-large. Trigger script: 
```
for i in {1..40}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-large","prompt":"x","max_tokens":1000}' &
done
wait
```
Observed pattern: initial scatter of requests saturates slice-A + slice-C on same physical GPU -> KV cache thrash -> per-token latency jumps -> API returns 429s as the serving runtime hits per-slice queue limit.

carla_engineer: Confirmed similar behavior in our bench: fractional packing left multiple small slices on same device; when two heavy slices align they both use SM concurrently and heat up, even though isolation nominal. Autoscaler added another small slice, but scheduler packed it onto gpu-13 as well because of bin-packing policy.

carla_engineer: Quick mitigation steps we used: 1) temporarily mark eu2-dedicated-7 as "no-new-packs" for slice sizes 1g to force fresh allocation; 2) bump pool min_replicas by 1 to avoid oversubscribing existing nodes; 3) run defrag tool to migrate small slices off gpu-13 during low-traffic window.

maria_support: Can we provide FathomAI a short-term opt: pin to a different pool or reduce concurrency guidance? They need a fix now or we'll escalate.

dan_devops: I bumped min_replicas for eu2-dedicated-7 +1 and kicked an autoscale rebalance (job id: rebalance-2309123465). If this doesn't lower p95 in 10m, we can evacuate slice-C off gpu-13 and reprovision elsewhere. Also enabled stricter packing thresholds for 1g slices (bin_threshold -> 0.15).

jon_eng: Also recommend a runtime change: when per-slice SM>85% and queue depth rising, throttle burst tokens earlier (soft 429 with Retry-After) to avoid KV cache thrash. I'll file a small patch.

maria_support: I messaged the customer with mitigations: pin to alternate pool, reduce concurrent streams, and we escalated for evacuation if persists. Will report back in 10m. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Action log: rebalance-2309123465 started by dan_devops at 2309123466.

maria_support: Update — after rebalance p95 dropped from ~1.2s/token to ~280ms and 429s reduced to <1% of requests. Customer confirms improvement. Closing for now but leaving follow-up on scheduler heuristics / fractional packing.

carla_engineer: Filed follow-up ticket INF-4921 to tweak bin-packing and add defensive early-throttle.

maria_support: Thanks all — recording notes in customer ticket and will ping when INF-4921 has a patch.
